pages.text: Client-side helpers that make big inventories bearable. $(thing)Inventory Profiles Next$() sorts and moves items. $(thing)Mouse Tweaks$() speeds up mouse use. $(thing)Shulker Box Tooltip$() previews contents. Settings are in the Mods menu.

pages.title: Inventory Profiles Next
pages.text: Sorts your inventory or a container with a button or key, moves matching stacks and can lock slots. Many options live in its config screen; right-click to reset a key.

pages.title: Shulker Box Tooltip
pages.text: Hover a shulker box to see what is inside.

$(bold)Mouse Tweaks$() adds drag-split: hold click and drag over slots to spread a stack. Scroll the wheel over a slot to move items between inventories. $(br2)Containers: $(l:home/storage)Storage$(/l).
